name: chesspecker-i18n
description: Inline translations, hover, go-to-definition and diagnostics for the ULID-based transloco keys

chesspeckerI18n.langs.description: Languages to resolve. Empty means the defaults from tools/scripts/i18n/config.mjs.

chesspeckerI18n.inlineText.description: Render the default language translation in place of every key usage.

chesspeckerI18n.inlineTextMaxLength.description: Characters shown before the inline translation is ellipsised.
